children: Marygold Companies, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $25.3M and a net loss of $4.4M, an improvement from a $5.8M loss a year earlier; diluted EPS was $(0.10) for FY 2026 versus $(0.14) in FY 2025.
Revenue was $25.313M for FY 2026, compared with $23.434M in FY 2025; YoY change 8%.
Net income was a net loss of $4.371M for FY 2026, compared with a net loss of $5.820M in FY 2025; YoY change (25%).
Diluted EPS was $(0.10) for FY 2026, compared with $(0.14) for FY 2025 (improved).
Fund-management revenue rose 23%, driven by assets under management increasing to $4.1B; overall revenue grew 8% year-over-year.
The company sold its security systems business (Brigadier) in July 2025 and classified its food products as discontinued, sharpening focus on fund management and beauty.
Original Sprout brand revenue increased 13%, with margin improvement attributed to greater control of e-commerce and expanded distribution in Asia.
Operational actions included pausing U.S. and U.K. fintech app development between April and June 2025–2026 and implementing enhanced trade controls after a $2.5M USO execution error.
